Container.Name: openclaw-assistant
Container.Overview: Private OpenClaw assistant for Unraid. Discord for text/notifications; OpenClaw Android/Wear OS app for voice; Gmail IMAP and Google Calendar via a service-account key; Obsidian notes. Intended for access over WireGuard. No Docker socket, no privileged mode.
Container.Requires: Dedicated Google account and Gmail app password; Google Calendar API service-account JSON key shared into the Assistant calendar; Discord bot application; OpenCode Zen API key. Appdata must be on the cache pool or a direct disk, not /mnt/user. Do not add the Docker socket.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: OpenClaw state, SQLite, memory, credentials. Use cache pool/direct disk, not /mnt/user.

Config.Name: Obsidian Vault
Config.Description: Select your Obsidian vault root. The assistant writes under the Assistant subfolder. Must be writable by UID 1000.

Config.Name: Google Credentials
Config.Description: Folder containing service-account.json downloaded from a Google Cloud service account. Mounted read-only.

Config.Name: Gateway Token
Config.Description: Long random token. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32

Config.Name: OpenCode API Key
Config.Description: OpenCode Zen API key.

Config.Name: Primary Model
Config.Description: OpenClaw model ref. Recommended: opencode/claude-haiku-5-5. Other paid options: opencode/deepseek-v4.1-flash, opencode/glm-5.3-flash. Free models may return 403 outside the OpenCode client.

Config.Name: Discord Bot Token
Config.Description: Token for a NEW OpenClaw Discord bot application. Do not reuse an existing Red bot token.

Config.Name: Discord Owner ID
Config.Description: Your Discord user ID. Enable Developer Mode, right-click your avatar, Copy User ID.

Config.Name: Discord Guild ID
Config.Description: Optional private Discord server/guild ID.

Config.Name: Discord Channel ID
Config.Description: Optional dedicated #assistant channel ID.

Config.Name: Assistant Email
Config.Description: Dedicated Google account email, e.g. assistant.you@gmail.com.

Config.Name: Gmail App Password
Config.Description: Google app password for IMAP/SMTP. Not the account password.

Config.Name: Assistant Calendar ID
Config.Description: Google Calendar ID, e.g. abc123@group.calendar.google.com.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: IANA timezone.

Config.Name: Owner Name
Config.Description: Your name for prompts and notifications.

Config.Name: Assistant Name
Config.Description: Name the assistant uses.

Config.Name: Quiet Hours
Config.Description: Owner local quiet hours. Urgent/VIP may bypass.

Config.Name: City
Config.Description: Optional city for the owner profile.

Config.Name: Work Hours
Config.Description: Owner working hours for scheduling.

Config.Name: Obsidian Subfolder
Config.Description: Subfolder inside the vault for assistant notes.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: OpenClaw HTTP/WebSocket port. Reachable over WireGuard; do not port-forward publicly.
